properties.description: Pins the owner's awaiting-word list (DesignGraph::awaiting_word, served on loop_status's scoped answer): a delivered proposed requirement is listed with what delivers it; a proposed idea whose promotion landed is listed with what it became, and the listed ideas are exactly what decision_overtaken_by_promotion reports; accepted ones and undelivered or unlanded ones are not listed; the scoped loop_status lists them, names them in next, keeps clean, leaves the unscoped list empty and moves no status.
